augmentation_rng: none: fixed per-trajectory H+S; never consumes sampler/model RNG
microbatch_status: pending actual full-effective-batch GPU test, identical for all arms
formal_init: reload same newly constructed untrained step0; discard calibration and startup endpoints
precision: official mixed FP16 torso / FP32 masters; fixed loss scale256; fail on nonfinite, no silent scaler/precision changes

DINO.source_identity_status: local weight path/revision/hash must be verified before GPU execution

loss.reconstruction: 0.5*(mean L1+mean MSE branch0 + mean L1+mean MSE branch1)
loss.feature_reduction: mean over effective B,2 cameras,196 patches,1024 channels

calibration_rule: 100 rec-only paired updates on train, separate sampler. Same fixed 128 train pairs at10/30/60/100. lambda=min(median(0.1*g_rec/g_cons), min(0.1*L_rec/L_cons)) over those four nodes. Require all poststartup unscaled encoder norms finite and >1e-12; otherwise STOP, no alternate calibration/search. step0 measured/excluded due zero output layer. Freeze before all three 200-update runs; AE-cons applies from update1.
latent_normalization: At each evaluation node compute per-position mean and global RMS scale on same fixed 128 training pairs, pooled both appearances; no validation fitting; report raw/unit/standardized distances, raw norms variance rank; near-zero scale marked invalid, not hidden.
shuffle_z: fixed derangement among validation samples in same task when possible; no self pairing; record task/horizon differences; unavailable groups explicitly missing
